name: priest_of_the_order
description: a Priest of the Order, a bearded cleric of Junil with short swept brown hair and a brown beard, white-and-gold vestments with red-and-gold stoles, a brown belt with a gold buckle, blue-grey sleeves, a long red cape hanging behind him, brown boots, a tall silver staff topped with a gold sunburst over a ribbed silver head in his LEFT hand, and a red-and-gold holy book held at his hip in his RIGHT hand
hands: the sunburst staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side keeps hold of the red-and-gold holy book

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the red-and-gold holy book flung out to the left in his right hand, the sunburst staff thrown up and out), the red cape flaring
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the sunburst staff dipping, the holy book still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the sunburst staff flung up, the arm with the holy book drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the sunburst staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the silver staff tipped down with its gold sunburst head resting on the ground, the arm with the holy book hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the sunburst staff slips out of the hand, the holy book drops, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the silver sunburst staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the holy book lies beside him; the red cape spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the red cape settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the sunburst staff and the holy book on the ground beside him
